title: Export a typed song constructor
prompt: The supplied `model.ts` exports the type `Song` with `id` and `title` fields. Import that type and export `makeSong(id: number, title: string): Song`. Return an object with exactly those two fields.
hints: `export` in front of the function makes it visible to other files.
Build the return object from the two parameters.
typeChecks: __Equal<typeof answer.makeSong, (id: number, title: string) => { id: number; title: string }>

wrongAnswers.misconception: Returns the same title every time.
